imgAlt: Create and style Integrated Charts from your data grid
title: Integrated Charts
content: Build charts directly from grid data. Users can create their own visualisations or you can create them programmatically.

imgAlt: Group rows by multiple columns with automatic aggregations
title: Row Grouping
content: Group data by one or more columns with automatic aggregations. Users can expand, collapse, and drag columns to group.

imgAlt: Display hierarchical data with expandable detail grids
title: Master/Detail
content: Expandable rows that contain fully featured detail grids with their own data and configuration.

imgAlt: Load data on-demand with the Server-Side Row Model
title: Server-Side Row Model
content: Handle millions of rows by loading data on-demand. Supports server-side sorting, filtering, and grouping.
